verdict.rationale: GitHub docs claim CLI can 'query and edit large codebases' and its 1M-token context window is designed to let the agent explore code without manual file selection, and one HN user corroborates that it navigated large codebases 'effortlessly.' However, other hands-on reports directly contradict this, describing it as 'stupid at navigation in the codebase' taking 10x longer, getting 'stuck in spaghetti code,' and ignoring its own GEMINI.md context files. missing for 10: consistent independent benchmarks of whole-codebase mapping, resolution of the navigation-quality contradiction, and detail on automatic (vs manual --include-directories) context selection.
